chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Ali ibn Isa, from his uncle, who said:
I said to him, 'Teach me a supplication with which I may supplicate for a pain that has afflicted me.' He said, 'Say it while you are in prostration.'

O Allah, O Beneficent, O Merciful, O Lord of the lords, and God of the gods, and O King of the kings, and O Master of the masters, heal me with Your healing from every ailment and sickness, for I am Your servant, turning about in Your grip.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication for healing pain while in prostration?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this supplication emphasizes the spiritual potency of reciting during prostration (sajdah), a position of humility and closeness to the Divine. It invokes Allah’s supreme sovereignty and mercy, framing the supplicant as a servant entirely within God's grasp, reflecting the Shia tradition of seeking healing through both physical means and spiritual devotion.
